motivation: Early batch stops lost money and a 20% account stop from inception halted before the later peak. Test fixed profit milestones without picking the historical peak date.
rules: Use the original grid. Activate an account trailing exit only after net account equity first reaches a fixed multiple of original capital. On a subsequent drawdown from its running high, close all positions and permanently stop. Idle cash earns zero. No replenishments or restarts.
experiments: Both grid sizing modes, 2019 and fresh 2022 accounts, both assumed minute paths. Report every result, including controls that never activate before margin liquidation.
limitations: This is an adaptive second round on already-inspected data, not an independent test. Stop thresholds can be exceeded by gaps and costs. No best historical row is treated as a validated strategy.
